diagnostic_limitations: Uses hidden next clues to measure immediate candidate reduction. It is not an agent baseline, optimal strategy, or proof-depth metric; equal immediate gains can hide future differences.

manifest.analysis: All budgets and policies declared together; exploratory development diagnostics.
manifest.failure_policy: Inconclusive episodes count incorrect and are reported; no exclusions.
manifest.solver_limits: 60 seconds and 50000 calls per episode; 10 seconds/2 deterministic work units per solve.

menu_prior_diagnostic.interpretation: Measures answer-correlated catalogue metadata from generator sampling; it is a shortcut diagnostic, not logical evidence or a model result.
menu_prior_diagnostic.method: Guess among suspects with fewest/most publicly named unary evidence items; uniform tie expectation computed analytically. No clue content or hidden world used to select suspects.
